description: An orange panel over black, masked by a centred rectangle half the frame each way whose clip carries `blur: 0.05`: an orange square with a soft, feathered edge ramping smoothly to black over a few pixels on every side, solid orange in its middle. The feathering comes from the matte clip's own blur, with no property of its own. What a wrong render looks like: a hard-edged square means the matte's blur was not applied to the mask; a white or grey halo means the matte was drawn on its own track; an orange frame edge-to-edge means the matte was dropped.
